meta.name: Hearthwatch sample
meta.notes: Homebrew names plus SRD-template stubs only. No product-identity creatures.

actors.name: Mira Reed
actors.notes: Class chassis stub. Sneak Attack +1d6; keeps the first-aid kit.

actors.name: Calden Moss
actors.notes: Class chassis stub. Fighting Style; Second Wind (1/rest).

actors.name: Eldra Voss
actors.notes: Class chassis stub. Spellcasting (INT); Arcane Recovery. Not a spell database.

actors.name: Wolf
attacks: Bite +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing.
actors.notes: Keen Hearing and Smell; Pack Tactics.

actors.name: Goblin
attacks: Scimitar +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Shortbow +4, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
actors.notes: Nimble Escape (Disengage or Hide as a bonus action).

actors.name: Skeleton
attacks: Shortsword +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
Shortbow +4, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
actors.notes: Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to poison; exhaustion.

actors.name: Guard
attacks: Spear +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing.

actors.name: Ogre
attacks: Greatclub +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning.
Javelin +6, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing.
actors.notes: Large brute lurking past the mill road.
